message: 絆は誰も裏切らない

name: Soltia
message: 「Gah... Ngh...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems the battle has been decided.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot, were you able to destroy the magic circle?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. I did not destroy it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? W-What do you mean?」

name: Soltia
message: 「I see... So that's it... If it wasn't the magic circle, then your true objective is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why won't you show yourself, Virus?!」

name: Soltia
message: 「He's not coming... By now, he's probably watching from the sidelines...」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is the meaning of this? You two were supposed to be allies.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Tell me, Soltia!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Heehee... Judging by that irritation, you must have been quite confident in yourself. In the end, even you can only live within your own limits...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just answer me!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「As if... I'd ever believe a word... a Demon says...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She vanished...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It appears her vessel has returned to the Demon World. Given how badly damaged it was, she won't even be able to set foot in the Human World anymore.」

name: Ria
message: 「Melilot, was it really okay not to destroy the magic circle?」

name: Melilot
message: 「My apologies. I didn't mean to deceive you, but I wanted you all to focus on Soltia.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was preparing to fight Virus. However, he never came. He abandoned his own ally, Soltia.」

name: Synn
message: 「If he didn't come to help her, does that mean Virus doesn't actually need this magic circle...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't know. What on earth could his goal be...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, you all did a splendid job defeating Soltia.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, come to think of it」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm amazed. To think that just having the President by my side would make this much power overflow within me」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I was able to fight better than usual as the Demon Lord, too」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not your imagination. Creating synergy--this is the true power a Demon Lord possesses……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Congratulations, everyone of the Crusaders」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah…… T-Thank you very much」

name: Ria
message: 「We did it, Synn-kun! Revenge is a huge success♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah…… yes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To actually defeat an opponent that strong, the Crusaders are practically invincible now!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course. The word defeat doesn't exist in our vocabulary」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, let's throw a party to celebrate our victory!!」

name: Ria
message: 「At Synn-kun's house, of course\s04」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yaaaay!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia has departed. However, Virus is still out there……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Virus possesses enough power that even Soltia holds back…… Even against the Crusaders, there's no telling what might happen……」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, there is still hope……. For now, let us simply rejoice in their growth」

name: Synn
message: 「Would you like to join us too, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eh……. B-But going outside the academy isn't really――」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's go, Melilot! It's a great chance to cure that shut-in habit of yours♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-Helena!? Since when were you here!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, let's gooo!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Aaaaaahhh」
